name: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
summary_text: Covered by the dedicated country dossier, which located no Mecklenburg-Vorpommern-specific trans statute, ordinance, enforcement series or event-security finding; risk tracks the national framework. The dossier's documented attacks on Pride events in eastern Germany are located in neighbouring Länder (Sachsen, Brandenburg), not here.

sources.claim_summary: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (anti-bot 'Access denied' interstitial); per the country dossier this 16 July 2026 France24/wire report covers the neo-Nazi prisoner (the 'Liebich' case) placed in a men's prison despite a legal gender change - the event that drove Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia to launch a Bundesrat initiative to tighten the federal Self-Determination Act. Framework-level for all Länder.

sources.title: Selbstbestimmung hinter Gittern
sources.claim_summary: Verfassungsblog constitutional-law essay (Clara Wellhäußer, 18 March 2026) on Länder prison-execution reforms for trans inmates: a majority of states have replaced placement rules unchanged since the 1970s (Rhineland-Palatinate § 17 in force 1 March 2026, plus Bavaria, Saxony, Hamburg), all anchoring placement to the registry sex entry; the author finds the approach constitutionally avoidable and some versions doubtful. National framework analysis.

sources.title: How German prisons deal with trans inmates
sources.claim_summary: DW report (23 August 2023) on trans inmates in German prisons (the Penelope Frank case): the prison-staff union reports men's prisons inadequately prepared and understaffed (~2,000 officer shortage; ~60,000 inmates in nearly 200 facilities); prisons are Länder jurisdiction, some states with special facilities or guidelines. National framework context.
